The test should not be carried out when compaction plant is operating
nearby, or when ground vibrations are present.

The calibration of the sand is sensitive to humidity and should be
checked daily. The sand should be oven-dried and stored for about a week for
the moisture content to reach equilibrium with atmospheric humidity. After
each test, the sand should be dried and sieved to remove any extraneous
material before further use.

27.3 CORE CUTTER METHOD

The core cutter method Is described In BSI (19756). The method
depends upon being able to drive a cylindrical cutter into the soll without
significant change of density and to retain the sample inside It so that the
known Internal volume of the cylinder is completely filled. It Is therefore
restricted to fine soils that are sufficiently cohesive for the sainple not to fall
out, and to completely decomposed rock free of large fragments. The method
fs generally Jess accurate than the sand replacement method because driving
the sampler tends to alter the density of the soll.

27.4 WEIGHT IN WATER METHOD

The welght in water method is described In BSI (19756). It fs applicable
to any soll where representative samples occur fn discrete lumps that will not
disintegrate during handling and submersion in water. In practice the method
fs restricted mainty to cohesive salts.

27,5 WATER DISPLACEMENT METHOD

The water displacement method Is described In BSI (1975bh). It Ig an
alternative to the weight in water method and has the same limitations.

27.6 RUBBER BALLOON METHOD

A description of the rubber balloon, or densometer, method can be found
Int ASTM (19856). In essence it fs a water replacement test with a rubber
membrane retaining the water. It Is an alternative to the sand replacement
Method with the limitation that It fs not suitable for very soft soll which will
deform under slight pressure, or in which the volume of the hole cannot be
maintained constant. The ASTM standard does not describe the apparatus In
precise terms and hence the method could be used for coarser soils than the
sand replacement method If a sufficiently large apparatus were constructed.
